dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped rings show a sharp gradient transition from the dark-brown exterior coat to a high-contrast cream-colored perimeter. The edge geometry is slightly irregular and non-perfectly circular, with the light-colored bands maintaining a relatively uniform width.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of small, solid, low-intensity dark spots are present both within the centers of the annuli and scattered throughout the lighter-pigmented dorsal regions. These spots demonstrate no visible internal pixel gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form a non-equilateral quadrilateral. The three largest rings located towards the anterior section of the trunk form an obtuse triangle with its widest angle directed ventrally.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent light-colored circumorbital rings and distinct, high-contrast dark claw tips on the pectoral flipper are clearly visible.
